ContentInfo

Represents content information for a resource, including its file extension and binary data.

ContentLoader

Provides a simple wrapper to load all types of Raylib resources and JSON strings.

ContentManager

Provides a simple class to load content and automatically unload all loaded content when close is called.

ContentManagerPacked

Provides a simple class to load content that was packed with the ContentPacker.

ContentPacker

Packs all files from a folder structure into a single text file. Each resource is stored as two lines: the first line is the file name with extension, and the second line is the compressed, Base64-encoded file data.

A container class that stores and manages a collection of IDataObject instances by their names.

SavegameObject

Simple base class for a savegame object that can be serialized and deserialized. To properly serialize and save instances of this class, every property must have a public getter and setter.
